nodes.label: Fallback Chain
nodes.rationale: Ordered list of models in a Model Slot used for failover.

nodes.label: Inbox
nodes.rationale: Central place for items requiring Owner decision (drafts, tasks, blocked messages).

nodes.label: Linked Account
nodes.rationale: Telegram account linked to a teleX Owner via encrypted session.

nodes.label: Model Catalog
nodes.rationale: List of available AI models, their capabilities, and costs.

nodes.label: Model Profile
nodes.rationale: Named choice of models for AI helpers, consisting of three Model Slots.

nodes.label: Model Slot
nodes.rationale: Specific job (text, vision, image) within a Model Profile.

nodes.label: Operator
nodes.rationale: Person who deploys and administers the teleX installation.

nodes.label: Owner
nodes.rationale: Person with a teleX account who owns linked Telegram accounts.

nodes.label: Passkey
nodes.rationale: Passwordless sign-in key confirmed with biometrics or PIN.

nodes.label: Status Banner
nodes.rationale: Persistent strip reporting conditions affecting the whole teleX installation.
